measurementScope: Recorded observation boundary through technical validation, independent failure diagnosis and S05 contract review; 21m11s. Earlier reading/delegation and subsequent final documentation, integrity review and local commit are outside this interval. Not entire RUN-005 elapsed work.
goalAggregateScope: Cumulative goal tool counters include earlier goal work and delegated processing. Not isolated RUN-005 usage, model input/output/cache/reasoning breakdown, account billing or money.

goal.objective: EasyWeb WORK_SPEC S05~S10을 이어서 구현·검증·인계하고 10/10 인수 조건을 충족한다. 실제 사용자·실제 환경 증거가 필요한 조건은 조작하지 않으며 가능한 독립 작업을 모두 완료하고 남은 조건을 구체화한다.

differenceFromPreviousCheckpoint.scope: Difference between cumulative goal snapshots only. This interval begins before RUN-005 recorded observation boundary and cannot isolate this run or billable use.
